newsitem.title: CANADA: Wascana shrs rise as players bet on new bid.
newsitem.headline: Wascana shrs rise as players bet on new bid.

text.p: Shares in Wascana Energy Inc rose on Thursday in hectic early action on the Toronto Stock Exchange as investors wagered an offer will emerge to rival the C$18.50 per share bid from Talisman Energy Inc.
"Obviously people are thinking it's worth more than what they're offering for it," said one equity dealer.
"I think it's mostly the (arbitrageur) guys trying to force somebody's hand into paying more and who knows, they may succeed," he added.
Wascana shares shot to a 52-week peak of 19.25 on the TSE before settling back to trade 1.80 higher at 18.75.
Turnover was a heavy 5.68 million shares.
Talisman Energy shares were up 1.20 at 46.35 in more moderate trade.
"I would not be surprised if you...see a better offer for Wascana, either from Talisman or from another white knight," another trader said.
Talisman on Wednesday said it would bid C$18.50 cash or 0.41 of one of its shares for each share of Wascana, a former Saskatchewan government-owned oil company.
Rumors had swirled about a bid for Wascana for several weeks, dealers said.
A third trader called the agreement: "The worst-kept secret in the oilpatch for the past couple of months."
